st: In episode 5, Hasan marries Aisha, loses her during the 1947 Partition, and is reunited with their daughter Sana.

The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Choosing to save a police truck full of GRC staff over chasing Karli, Walker fights beside Sam and Bucky, then goes to work for Valentina as U.S. Agent.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Sent to an O.X.E. vault to kill rival operatives, Walker escapes with them and names them the Thunderbolts. Walker helps pull Bob back from the Void and is unveiled as one of the New Avengers.
Rhodey finds Tony in the desert and later covers for him with the military and the press.
Rhodey takes one of Tony's suits to the Air Force and fights Vanko's drones as War Machine.
Rebranded as the Iron Patriot, Rhodey is captured by Killian's men and helps Tony save the President.
Rhodey joins the battle in Sokovia, then becomes one of the new Avengers.
Rhodey sides with Tony over the Accords and is badly hurt when Vision's blast hits him by mistake.
Walking with braces, Rhodey fights Thanos's army in Wakanda and survives the Snap.
At the Avengers Compound, Rhodey is with the survivors when Carol Danvers arrives looking for Fury.
Rhodey goes to Morag with Nebula for the Time Heist and fights in the final battle.
In episode 1, Rhodey stands with Sam at the Smithsonian as Sam hands Steve's shield over to the museum.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
A Skrull named Raava has been posing as Rhodey. The real Rhodey is freed from a Skrull prison when Gravik falls.
In 1995, young Monica urges her mother to fly with Carol against the Kree.
In episode 4, Monica returns from the Blip to find her mother has died, then is pulled into the Westview Hex while investigating it for S.W.O.R.D.
In episode 7, back from the Blip, Monica enters the Westview Hex for S.W.O.R.D. and gains powers.
Monica's powers become linked with Carol's and Kamala's, and she ends up stranded in another universe.
Posing as Steve's neighbor, Agent 13 guards him for Fury, then helps stop HYDRA.
Sharon speaks at Peggy's funeral, secretly gets Steve and Sam their gear back, and has to flee.
Hiding in Madripoor, Sharon shelters Sam and Bucky, then follows them to New York to help stop the Flag Smashers.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
In episode 3, the hacker Skye joins Coulson's team and trains to be a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent.
In episode 32, Terrigen Mist gives her earthquake powers, and she learns her birth name is Daisy Johnson.
In episode 66, Daisy leads the Secret Warriors, falls under Hive's control, and loses Lincoln.
Now a rogue vigilante called Quake, Daisy saves Elena from Victor Ramon's men and later covers for her.
In episode 81, Daisy returns to S.H.I.E.L.D. and goes into the Framework to free her friends from Aida.
In episode 98, she is sent to 2091 with the team and helps free the Lighthouse from the Kree.
In episode 123, Daisy leads a search through space for Fitz, then returns to Earth to fight Sarge and Izel.
In season 7, she fights the Chronicoms across time, then explores space with Sousa and her sister Kora.
In episode 38, Jiaying's hidden haven of Afterlife guides new Inhumans like Skye through their changes.
In episode 44, Jiaying leads Afterlife into war on S.H.I.E.L.D., and the haven is lost when she and Gordon are killed.
In episode 133, in a changed past, Nathaniel Malick seizes Afterlife and gives Gordon's powers to John Garrett, killing Gordon. He then kills Jiaying at the Lighthouse.
In episode 2, Beth spends a night with Frank, is shot in the bar fight, and is threatened by Pilgrim in the hospital.
In episode 55, Elena, an Inhuman whose bursts of speed snap her back to where she started, joins Daisy's Secret Warriors.
After signing the Sokovia Accords, Elena hunts her cousin's killer, Victor Ramon, but chooses not to kill him.
In episode 86, Elena grows close to Mack and helps Daisy and Simmons get into the Framework.
In episode 89, Elena is carried off with Coulson's team to a space station in 2091, where the Kree capture her and Mack until Daisy frees them.
In episode 106, Ruby Hale slices off Elena's arms, and Elena later kills her.
In episode 123, an alien Shrike infects Elena.
In season 7, she regains her powers, now with true super-speed, and becomes one of S.H.I.E.L.D.'s top agents.
In episode 9, Father Lantom hears Matt's confessions and challenges him on the devil he sees in Wilson Fisk.
In episode 4, Lantom hears Matt's guilt over failing to save Grotto and tells him that guilt can be a call to action.
In episode 1, Lantom counsels Matt as he weighs putting the mask back on.
In episode 10, Lantom shelters the injured Matt and later Karen, and is killed by Dex while shielding her at Clinton Church.
In episode 10, Lawyer Jeri Hogarth hires Jessica and fights a bitter divorce while Kilgrave targets her.
Jeri hires Foggy away to her firm.
In episode 3, Jeri proves Danny Rand's identity in exchange for a contract with Rand Enterprises.
In episode 2, Jeri warns Jessica off the case and keeps the fallout away from her firm.
Diagnosed with ALS, Jeri fights her partners and leaves with enough money to start her own firm.
Jeri defends Sallinger, tries to help Trish flee the country, and loses Kith.
In episode 37, Lance Hunter, the mercenary Coulson has used since Creel killed Hartley's team, agrees to become a permanent S.H.I.E.L.D. agent.
In episode 57, after a mission in Russia, Hunter and Bobbi are disavowed and leave S.H.I.E.L.D.
In episode 93, Hunter breaks Fitz out of a military prison and helps him go after the missing team.
In episode 63, Agent Piper joins May's strike team and fights beside Coulson's agents.
In episode 81, Piper flees the Playground on the Zephyr as it is blown up, then helps log Daisy and Simmons into the Framework.
In episode 99, Piper makes a deal with General Hale to hand over the returning team, then turns and helps them escape.
In episode 120, Piper searches space for Fitz with Daisy and Davis, then watches Izel possess Davis and send him to his death.
In season 7, Piper helps protect Fitz, Simmons and their daughter while the Chronicoms are beaten.
In episode 3, Agent Krzeminski belittles Peggy until Dottie Underwood kills him.
In episode 11, Agent Ray Nadeem works Fisk's deal, then learns the truth and turns on him with Matt's help.
In episode 12, Nadeem testifies against Fisk before a rigged grand jury and is killed by Dex.
In episode 6, Born in the Hex with his twin Billy, Tommy discovers he has super-speed.
Tommy helps defend his family, then fades with Billy as Wanda ends the Hex.
In episode 8, Billy finds Tommy's soul and places it in the body of a drowning boy.
In episode 1, Now a pickpocket named Thomas Shepherd, he is captured by Paladin after claiming to be Vision's son.
Vision rescues Tommy, who uses his speed to reboot Vision and helps him hunt the Butcherbird Killer. Tommy leaves the Markridge gala with Ultron, who has seized control of Vision's body.
In episode 6, Paladin, who took Tommy from Ultron, uses him as bait in Madripoor, but Tommy escapes with Lisa and uses his powers to save her from Jocasta's nanobot.
Vision is born with the Mind Stone, lifts Mjolnir, and helps destroy Ultron.
Vision sides with Tony, but his blast hits Rhodey by mistake.
Vision hides with Wanda in Scotland until Thanos tears the Mind Stone from his head.
In Westview, the Vision Wanda made fades away, while a rebuilt white Vision regains his memories and flies off.
In episode 2, living in Edinburgh, Vision is hunted by the bounty hunter Paladin and rescues Tommy, who claims to be his son.
To stop the killer Jocasta, Vision lets Ultron take control, but Ultron locks him out and leaves with Tommy.
In episode 6, after lowering his firewall to retake his body, which lets Ultron escape, Vision reaches Madripoor with Lisa, fights off the Ten Rings with Tommy's help, and flees with him.
Freed from Red Room control, Yelena teams up with Natasha to take down Dreykov and free the Widows.
At Natasha's grave, Valentina tells Yelena that Clint Barton killed her sister.
As Yelena moves in to finish Clint on the ice, he whistles the tune she shared with Natasha, and she breaks down.
Clint tells Yelena how much Natasha loved her, and she helps him up and walks away.
Yelena leads a team of outcasts to save New York from the Void, and they become the New Avengers.
Now the Black Widow, Yelena helps Spider-Man dig into Damage Control's secrets.
In season 5, Fitz steals a cryo pod from Hale's base and sleeps in it on Enoch's ship for 74 years to reach the team.
In season 6, Enoch wakes Fitz from the pod early, just before a strange energy spiral cuts his ship in half.
In season 6, Daisy and Simmons track half of Enoch's wrecked ship to the D'Rillian scavenger Trok and find the cryo pod empty.
Hope, Janet and Hank steal Lord Krylar's ship as they flee his city.
M.O.D.O.K. destroys the ship with Hank aboard, while Kang captures Janet.
Hank's ants find him and repair the ship, and he flies it to Axia for the final battle.
In season 3, in 1839, English lords draw stones by lottery, and the loser must walk into the room that holds the Monolith.
In season 2, the Monolith sits in the Iliad's cargo hold. Later, it swallows Simmons.
In season 3, Fitz learns it is a portal and brings Simmons back from an alien planet just as Daisy shatters it.
In season 5, a monolith sends the team to 2091 and back. Later, a bomb shatters three monoliths, and Coulson, then Daisy, seal the rift they leave behind with devices Fitz builds.
In season 6, Izel takes the monoliths' trapped energy and has a recreated Flint rebuild them as a portal.
In season 6, the Chronicoms destroy the rebuilt monoliths along with Izel's temple.
Sam scouts a Lagos market with his drone, Redwing.
In Wakanda, Sam sends Redwing slicing through Thanos's army, and it is left behind when Sam turns to dust.
Redwing flies with Sam against Batroc's hijackers over Tunisia.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
In Munich, Redwing chases the Flag Smashers' trucks until Karli Morgenthau leaps up and breaks it in half.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
Now Captain America, Sam sends Redwing to scan a Mexican cathedral for stolen adamantium and spots Sidewinder inside.
Melvin Potter builds a pair of billy clubs into the armored red suit he makes for Matt.
Melvin gives Matt a billy club with a steel cable inside, and Matt uses it to throw Nobu off a rooftop.
Matt fights the Hand with them beneath Midland Circle, until the building comes down on him.
Posing as Daredevil, Dex wields a copied billy club in his attack on the Bulletin, where he stabs Ellison in the gut with a pen.
In 2021, Daredevil parries Maya Lopez's strikes with a fresh pair of billy clubs.
In Los Angeles, Daredevil fights She-Hulk, then Leap-Frog's thugs, with clubs made by Luke Jacobson.
After Foggy's death, Matt takes his newer billy clubs out of hiding, then carries them again to save Angela.
Matt paints his billy club black along with his suit, then swings down onto the cargo ship Northern Star with it.
Tony brings Peter a new high-tech suit to fight Cap's team at Leipzig airport.
Peter and Ned unlock the suit's hidden features, but Tony takes it away after the ferry disaster.
After Peter stops the Vulture, Tony gives the suit back to him.
Peter chases Maw's ship in the Stark suit until Tony's Iron Spider forms over it. Both turn to dust with him in the Snap.
Five years later, Peter and his suits return from the Snap, and he fights Thanos's army in the Iron Spider.
On Happy's jet, Peter designs a new red and black suit for the fight in London.
After Strange's spell makes everyone forget Peter, he sews a new suit of his own.
Alone for four years as New York's anonymous hero, Peter builds and repairs his own suit with a homemade Fabricator.
Peter takes Frank's sniper round for Jean, and doctors cut the suit off him. Frank wears its surviving mask and gloves as a decoy.
Frank spray-paints a skull onto his body armor, copied from the X-ray of his own head printed in the paper.
Having wiped out the last of the gangs behind his family's deaths, Frank burns his skull vest.
Frank puts on the white skull again to defend the power station against Russo's soldiers.
Frank wears it to attack Billy's robbery crew, and the skull stirs Billy's nightmares.
In his skull vest, Frank takes on the Task Force cops who wear his symbol.
Frank locks up his Punisher gear, ready to end his life.
Frank returns to the streets in a new Punisher costume.
Frank wears his Punisher gear as he clashes with Spider-Man and later takes a shot at Jean Grey.
Adam Warlock attacks Knowhere to grab Rocket.
Wanting revenge for Ayesha's death, Adam crashes into Quill and Gamora's ship in the battle at Arête Laboratories.
Groot pulls Adam from the wreck of the Arête. Adam then saves Quill from dying in space and joins Rocket's new Guardians.
In episode 7, Nosy neighbor Agnes turns out to be Agatha, a witch who wants Wanda's power.
Wanda beats Agatha and traps her in Westview as Agnes.
In episode 2, freed from Wanda's spell by a teen, Agatha gathers a coven to walk the Witches' Road.
In episode 8, Agatha agrees to hand Billy over to Death to save herself, and ignores his pleas.
In episode 8, When Death makes Billy and Agatha choose who goes with her, Agatha kisses Rio and dies.
In episode 9, Agatha returns as a ghost and sets out with Billy to find Tommy.
Freed from an O.X.E. vault, Bob Reynolds helps the others escape, then Valentina makes him her Sentry and he turns on them.
His dark side, the Void, takes over and swallows New York in shadow.
The Thunderbolts reach Bob inside the Void and help him take back control. He then goes along with Valentina naming them the New Avengers.
Red Skull breaks HYDRA away from the Nazis and arms its troops with weapons powered by the Tesseract.
Steve and the Howling Commandos smash HYDRA's bases and capture Zola. Red Skull vanishes with the Tesseract.
In episode 30, in 1945, Peggy Carter's SSR raids HYDRA's last base in Austria and arrests its commander, Werner Reinhardt.
In 2012, HYDRA agents guard Loki's scepter inside S.H.I.E.L.D., and Steve fools them with a whispered Hail HYDRA.
In episode 8, in Sokovia, HYDRA scientists test the Mind Stone on Wanda Maximoff, and the stone reacts to her.
HYDRA reveals it grew in secret inside S.H.I.E.L.D. and launches Project Insight, until Steve's allies bring it down.
In episode 19, HYDRA agents like John Garrett and Grant Ward are exposed inside S.H.I.E.L.D. as the agency falls.
In episode 33, Daniel Whitehall's HYDRA hunts an alien Obelisk, until Coulson kills him and S.H.I.E.L.D. picks off its leaders.
The Avengers raid HYDRA's last base in Sokovia, take back Loki's scepter, and capture Baron Strucker.
HYDRA agent Mitchell Carson tries to buy the Yellowjacket suit and slips away with a vial of its formula.
In episode 54, Ward and Gideon Malick rebuild HYDRA to bring back its ancient master, the Inhuman Hive.
Zemo digs up HYDRA's 1991 mission that killed the Starks and kills its last frozen super soldiers in Siberia.
In episode 66, Hive takes over HYDRA's faithful, and Talbot's ATCU dismantles the rest. Hive later dies in space.
In episode 76, ex-HYDRA agents hired by the Watchdogs ambush Director Mace's team after their Quinjet goes down.
In episode 103, General Hale secretly serves HYDRA and raises her daughter Ruby to be its next leader.
In episode 108, the deaths of Ruby, Strucker and Hale bring Hale's HYDRA to an end.
In episode 128, S.H.I.E.L.D. must keep HYDRA's past intact, as the Chronicoms help Freddy Malick push its plans ahead.
Bucky makes amends for the killings HYDRA forced on him. Zemo kills Nagel, a scientist from HYDRA's super soldier program.
The Falcon and the Winter Soldier
In episode 1, B-15 hunts and arrests Loki variants for the TVA.
In episode 4, Sylvie enchants B-15 at Roxxcart, and on Lamentis-1 B-15 knocks Sylvie down and brings her in.
In episode 6, after Sylvie unlocks her memories, B-15 helps Loki and Sylvie fight Renslayer, then proves to TVA troopers that they are variants.
B-15 works with Mobius and Loki to keep the TVA and its timelines alive.
B-15 arrives at the TVA and takes Paradox into custody.
Loki learns he is a Frost Giant and takes Asgard's throne. He then falls from the Bifrost into the void.
Loki steals the Tesseract and leads a Chitauri invasion of New York, until the Avengers capture him.
Loki fights beside Thor against the Dark Elves, fakes his death, and takes Odin's throne in disguise.
Exposed by Thor, Loki lands on Sakaar and wins the Grandmaster's favor. He agrees to help Thor escape, then betrays him and is left stunned by an obedience disk.
Loki returns to Asgard with the Sakaar gladiators to help save its people, sets off Ragnarok at Thor's request, and makes peace with Thor aboard the Statesman.
Thanos kills Loki aboard the Asgardian refugee ship.
In 2012, the captured Loki grabs the Tesseract during the Avengers' time heist and escapes.
The TVA catches this escaped Loki, who slowly becomes its ally in the hunt for a dangerous variant.
With Mobius, Loki travels back in time to watch Victor Timely lecture, and warns that the man is terrifying.
Loki takes the throne at the end of time to hold the timelines together.
In episode 4, Maya Lopez leads the Tracksuit Mafia in hunting the Ronin who killed her father, and the hunt leads her to Clint Barton.
In episode 6, Maya kills Kazi when he refuses to break from Fisk, then confronts Fisk herself, and a gunshot rings out.
Back in Oklahoma, Maya defies Fisk, reconnects with her family, and breaks his hold on her.
Once a fake Ohio mother to Natasha and Yelena, Melina now works for Dreykov and signals the Red Room when they reach her farm with Alexei.
Melina shows her guests how her mind-control work lets Dreykov command the Widows.
Won over by Natasha, Melina trades faces with her to get into the Red Room, frees Alexei and Yelena, and disables one of its engines to bring it down.
In his first showdown with the Fantastic Four, Mole Man sinks the Pan Am Building and sets the monster Giganto loose.
The Fantastic Four thwart Mole Man's attack on the surface world.
At peace with the surface thanks to Sue, Mole Man shelters New York's evacuated people in Subterranea when Galactus comes.
Pietro is held in Strucker's HYDRA lab as a test subject.
Pietro and Wanda join Ultron to get back at Stark, and Pietro fights the Avengers at Klaue's salvage yard, until Wanda reads Ultron's mind in Seoul and sees he means to wipe out humanity.
Pietro and Wanda join the Avengers against Ultron in Sokovia, where Pietro dies shielding Clint from gunfire.
Under Agatha's spell, Ralph Bohner turns up at Wanda's door in Westview posing as Pietro, until Monica frees him.

Recorder Theel carries the passkey to Rocket's kill switch. Quill and Groot leap with him off the Arête, and once Groot glides them down, Quill slams him into the ground on Counter-Earth, killing him.
The Silver Surfer comes to Earth to herald Galactus, then chases the Fantastic Four's ship when they escape from Galactus.
Back on Earth, Johnny learns her name, Shalla-Bal, and her past, but she refuses to help the team and flees.
Shalla-Bal returns to stop Johnny from sacrificing himself, then pushes Galactus into the portal herself, and it closes behind them both.

Demoted after Loki is exposed, Skurge saves his own life by joining Hela, who makes him her executioner. He leads her army against the fleeing Asgardians, then drops his axe and hides aboard their ship.
Skurge turns on Hela's army to defend the fleeing Asgardians and dies holding them off on the Bifrost Bridge.
In episode 3, Alexandra raises Elektra as the Black Sky to reach the treasure under Midland Circle.
In episode 6, Elektra turns on Alexandra and kills her.
In episode 2, Wolf, tied to Rawlins's heroin smuggling, is killed by Frank at home.
In episode 103, the Confederacy offers to protect Earth in return for Inhumans and gravitonium.
In episode 115, a Confederacy cruiser attacks Daisy's ship in deep space. The Chronicoms also take Confederacy ships for their war.
In episode 20, Colonel Talbot leads the military hunt for Coulson's team after S.H.I.E.L.D. falls.
In episode 36, General Talbot keeps hunting S.H.I.E.L.D., until Coulson wins him over as an uneasy ally.
In episode 62, Talbot takes over the ATCU and betrays Coulson while Malick holds his son. He then leads the strike that wipes out HYDRA.
In episode 88, Talbot turns out to be behind Mace's Patriot serum. An LMD of Daisy later shoots him in the head.
In episode 108, Talbot absorbs gravitonium and sets out to save Earth his own way.
In episode 110, boosted by the Centipede serum, Daisy fights Talbot and blasts him into space to his death.
In episode 99, Ruby, raised by HYDRA, cuts off Yo-Yo's arms.
In episode 106, Yo-Yo kills Ruby with her own chakram.
In episode 2, Inmate Jasper Evans stabs Fisk on Fisk's own orders, getting him moved out of prison.
In episode 6, Evans is brought to the Bulletin to testify, and Dex kills him there before he can.
In episode 5, Years earlier, Detective Scarfe partners with Misty, jails Cockroach Hamilton, and breaks down after his son Earl dies.
In episode 6, Scarfe, Misty's corrupt partner, turns on Cottonmouth, who shoots him. Scarfe later dies of the wound.
In episode 1, a Roxxon scientist turns Howard Stark's stolen formula into nitramene bombs at one of the company's oil refineries.
In episode 13, Roxxon chief Hugh Jones sits on the Council of Nine, and a Roxxon site stores atomic bombs.
In episode 9, Elektra hacks Roxxon's servers, and Daredevil finds the Hand has infiltrated the company and kidnapped an accountant's son.
Feeling betrayed by Danny and Ward, Joy meets Davos in Paris and agrees that Danny must be removed.
In episode 4, Joy helps Davos steal the Iron Fist from Danny, hiring Mary Walker to spy on him and blackmailing an old friend for the ritual bowl.
In episode 9, Joy turns on Davos and lets his hostage BB go. Davos leaves her badly hurt, and Ward carries her to safety.
In episode 1, Raymond buys Howard Stark's stolen nitramene from Leet Brannis, and after Peggy takes it from his safe, a Leviathan assassin kills him.
In episode 84, inside the Framework, Fitz is the Doctor, who leads HYDRA with Madame Hydra. He kills Agnes and tortures Radcliffe and Daisy.
In episode 86, Radcliffe sends him out of the Framework. The real Fitz wakes up remembering every terrible thing he did.
In episode 104, Fitz lets his Doctor side take over and forces surgery on Daisy to remove her inhibitor. Afterward, she locks him up, until Simmons and Yo-Yo get Mack to free him.
In episode 110, fighting beside S.H.I.E.L.D., Fitz is buried in rubble and dies, but an earlier Fitz still sleeps in space.
In episode 116, Fitz wakes in space. When the Chronicoms trap his mind together with Simmons's, his Doctor side hunts them both.
In season 7, Fitz returns to help defeat the Chronicoms, then retires with Simmons and their daughter Alya.
In episode 2, with Danny locked in a psychiatric hospital, Ward sends men posing as patients to kill him.
In episode 9, Ward stabs his father Harold to death and lies to Danny about it, but Harold comes back to life.
In episode 13, Ward sides with Danny and shoots Harold, who falls from the Rand Enterprises roof. Ward has the body cremated so he cannot come back.
Ward faces his addiction at NA meetings, helps rescue Joy, then joins Danny on a journey across Asia.
In episode 4, Walker, a soldier hired by Joy and Davos to spy on Danny, drugs him and delivers him to the ritual that gives Davos the Iron Fist.
Talos hunts Vers on Earth, posing as Nick Fury's boss.
When Fury sees through his disguise, Talos tries to kill him. He then follows Vers to Maria Rambeau's home, where he reveals that the Skrulls are refugees and wins her help.
Talos poses as Nick Fury to guide Peter Parker through the Elemental attacks in Europe.
Talos helps Fury hunt Gravik's Skrull rebels, and Gravik kills him.
In episode 3, Sylvie attacks TVA Minutemen and plants reset charges across the Sacred Timeline, then fights Loki at the TVA until he steals her TemPad and takes them both to Lamentis-1.
In episode 6, Sylvie sends Loki away and kills He Who Remains, setting loose the multiverse.
Sylvie starts a quiet life in 1982 Oklahoma, then joins Loki's friends at the TVA as the Loom fails.
Spider-Man fights Tarantula aboard a passenger boat near the Williamsburg Bridge and captures him.
In episode 55, corrupt Colombian police colonel Ramon executes Elena's cousin Francisco and holds Hunter and Morse captive, until Mack knocks him out.
In episode 5, Ramon, the officer who killed Elena's cousin, tries to sell a HYDRA weapon to the Watchdogs.
When a Watchdog fires the weapon at Yo-Yo, its beam hits Ramon and kills him.
In episode 9, Zip provides muscle for Cottonmouth. After Cottonmouth's death, Diamondback makes Zip one of his advisers.
In episode 12, Sent by Diamondback to kill Shades, Zip loses the fight and is shot dead by Shades.
Kraglin recalls how Yondu ruined Christmas for a young Peter Quill aboard his ship.
The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
Yondu hunts Peter Quill for the Orb, but Peter hands him a fake.
Hired by Ayesha to bring in the Guardians, Yondu tracks them to Berhert and corners Rocket.
After Taserface's mutiny jails him, Yondu escapes with Rocket, Groot and Kraglin and helps the Guardians stop Ego. He dies in space saving Peter, and the Ravagers honor him at his funeral.
Hunters including Jovan, Azarel, Barasso and Liorn compete in Verussa's hunt for the Bloodstone.
Elsa kills three of the rival hunters and Ted kills the fourth, so none of them survives the night at Bloodstone Manor.
In episode 39, Iron Man teams with Spider-Man and Venom to stop Carnage and Dormammu, then shuts down the accelerator.
In episode 63, on the Beyonder's world, he fights beside Spider-Man's team and goes home with no memory of it.
In episode 10, Iron Man guards the White House with Captain America against Bastion's Prime Sentinels as Magneto's blackout ends.
In episode 61, on the Beyonder's world, the Invisible Woman and Storm recharge a lab to help Spider-Man's team.
In episode 2, Butane burns down a building as part of an insurance scam. Spider-Man beats him and finds a strange symbol on his gear.
Harry blames Spider-Man for his father's death and trades tritium to Doc Ock for Spider-Man. He unmasks Peter, then finds his father's hidden Goblin gear.
Harry attacks Peter on a glider, then loses his memory after a fall. His memory back, he forces Mary Jane to break up with Peter, and a pumpkin bomb scars his face.
When Peter asks for his help to save Mary Jane from Venom and Sandman, Harry turns him away.
Learning that Norman's death was not Spider-Man's fault, Harry joins Peter against Venom and Sandman. He takes the glider blow meant for Peter and dies of his wounds.

Otto Octavius's fusion demo fails, killing his wife Rosie and fusing his AI arms to his spine. Driven by the arms, he robs a bank to rebuild his reactor and takes Aunt May hostage. To get Harry Osborn's tritium, he fights Spider-Man on a train and delivers him to Harry.
Peter talks him down, and Otto sinks his reactor in the river, drowning with it.
Pulled across universes just before he drowns, he fights Peter on a bridge until Stark nanotech takes over his arms.
Doctor Strange locks him in a cell beneath the Sanctum, until Peter frees him and the other visitors to try to cure them.
At Happy's condo, Peter cures Otto with Stark technology. Otto later helps the Spider-Men cure Max at the Statue of Liberty and is sent home.
In episode 10, snubbed by the Science Hall of Fame, Dr. Matto Magneto seeks revenge and attacks Spider-Man with a magnetic gun.
In episode 6, the Green Goblin hypnotizes J. Jonah Jameson to summon demons from the spirit world.
In episode 19, Spider-Man webs him up in a cemetery and beats him with Blackwell's help, then stops him again after Dr. Noah Boddy frees him.
Aaron Davis takes his nephew Miles to paint graffiti in the station where Miles is bitten by the spider.
As the Prowler, Kingpin's enforcer, he guards the collider against Spider-Man, then hunts the boy who saw Spider-Man killed, not knowing it is Miles.
When Miles unmasks, Aaron cannot bring himself to kill his nephew, and Kingpin shoots him. He dies in Miles's arms.
In episode 6, Sir Ram convinces the High Evolutionary that Spider-Man must be dealt with and hires the Hunter to kill him.
In episode 54, in Moscow, Silver Sable's Wild Pack seize an informant and leave Spider-Man and Robertson with a ticking bomb.
In episode 55, she captures Spider-Man, the Kingpin and the Insidious Six.
In episode 57, Silver Sable and the Wild Pack turn up to help Spider-Man when the Red Skull traps him, the Kingpin and the Insidious Six.
In episode 9, after Peter rejects the alien symbiote, it bonds with reporter Eddie Brock, creating Venom.
In episode 10, the roar of a rocket launch tears the symbiote off Eddie, and Spider-Man sends it into space.
In episode 37, Baron Mordo returns Eddie's symbiote in exchange for serving Dormammu, and Venom fights Spider-Man and War Machine.
In episode 38, Venom and Carnage steal an interdimensional transporter for Mordo, and Venom goes after Spider-Man and J. Jonah Jameson until Iron Man and Dr. Ashley Kafka step in.
In episode 38, Eddie rebonds with the symbiote to help Spider-Man and Iron Man stop Dormammu, then pulls Carnage into the portal to save Dr. Kafka and vanishes with him.
